quests.name: Fresh From the Mud
quests.offer: Another one crawls out of the mud! Listen, little one: in Moss Mouth, a goblin who does not know the grocer goes hungry. Find Mudgrub by the cook pots and tell him the elder sent you.
quests.declined: Go hungry, then. The cavern feeds no one twice.
quests.started: Mudgrub keeps the cook pots, just south of here. Do not touch them.

steps.journal: Find Grocer Mudgrub by the cook pots in the great hall.
steps.says: The elder sent you? Here, eat this before someone takes it from you. It smells, but so do we.
Good. Mudgrub knows your face now, and you know where the food is. That is half of being a goblin.

quests.notes: Ours (the Homelands' starter quests, 2026-11-10): the goblins' first, at their home zone, Moss Mouth Cavern of the disc.

quests.name: Rats in the Larder
quests.offer: Tunnel rats are in my stores again, and they eat better than I do. Kill five of them down in the pit east of the hall, where they nest, and I will pay you in good coin.
quests.declined: Then the rats eat, and you do not.
quests.started: Five rats. Bring me none of their fleas.

steps.journal: Kill five tunnel rats in the pit east of the great hall.
Tell Grocer Mudgrub the rats are dead.
steps.says: Five rats! You are quicker than you look. Here is your pay. Do not spend it all in one place.

quests.notes: Ours: the goblins' second starter quest; the tunnel rats are tools/seed_race_homes.py's, passive (npcaggro).

quests.name: The Road to Neriak
quests.offer: The dark elves of Neriak pay well for goblins who are quick and quiet. I can send you to them, and Neriak will be your home from then on. Are you ready to go?
quests.declined: Neriak will wait. Dark elves are good at waiting.
quests.started: Keep your blade close and your purse closer!

steps.journal: Tell Gatekeeper Skabber when you are ready to go to Neriak.

quests.notes: Ours: the gatekeeper's port to Neriak, the goblin's wire race's city, each class to its own guild's spot there (teleport to mainland: the wire race's start row for the class), bound there. Repeatable, so a goblin back in Moss Mouth Cavern is sent again; no reward, so none is had twice.

quests.name: A Fledgling's Welcome
quests.offer: Another fledgling, fresh from the egg! Before you take wing, every young one of the Roost greets our grocer, Skreel, by the market nests. She will see you do not fly hungry.
quests.declined: The Roost will wait for you, little one.
quests.started: Go on, then. Skreel keeps the nests to the east.

steps.journal: Greet Grocer Skreel by the Roost's market nests.
steps.says: The elder sent you? Then take this for the road, fledgling.
Good. Now you know where to find your food, and Skreel knows your face.

quests.notes: Ours (the Homelands' starter quests, 2026-11-08): the aviaks' first, at their home zone, Aviak Village of the disc.

quests.name: Rats Among the Seed
quests.offer: Scrub rats have been at the seed stores again. Thin them out for me: five of them, out on the grass south of the nests.
quests.declined: Then the rats eat well tonight.
quests.started: Five of them. Mind their teeth.

steps.journal: Kill five scrub rats on the grass south of the Roost.
Tell Grocer Skreel the rats are dealt with.
steps.says: Five fewer thieves at the seed. Thank you, fledgling!

quests.notes: Ours: the aviaks' second starter quest; the rats are tools/seed_race_homes.py's, passive (npcaggro).

quests.name: The Long Flight
quests.offer: The winds are fair for the north, fledgling. The barbarians of Halas fight the giants beside us, and they will train you as their own. When you are ready, I will send you to them. Shall I?
quests.declined: The winds will wait for you.
quests.started: Fly well, and do not forget the Roost!

steps.journal: Tell Gatekeeper Windwhistle when you are ready to fly to Halas.

quests.notes: Ours: the gatekeeper's port to Halas, the aviak's wire race's city, each class to its own guild's spot there (teleport to mainland: the wire race's start row for the class), bound there. Repeatable, so a fledgling back in the Roost is sent again; no reward, so none is had twice.
